admin.domains_desc: The address visitors type to reach the website. Add your own domain, turn on the secure connection, then choose the main domain.
admin.domains_none_in_plan: The current plan has no own domain
admin.domains_limit_none: The current plan has no own domain.
admin.domains_limit_full: The current plan allows :l own domains (with and without www count as 1) — :u used. Remove a domain to add another.
admin.domains_limit_lost: Remove a stopped domain to add a new one.
admin.domains_empty_body: The website runs on a subdomain given by the platform. If you have your own domain (for example yourcompany.com), press “Add your own domain” — you are guided step by step.
admin.domains_st_https_err: Secure connection could not be turned on
admin.domains_st_failing: No longer points to the website
admin.domains_rowst_optional: Not pointed — point it when needed, then press Check
admin.domains_menu_primary_need_https: Turn on the secure connection first, then make it the main domain.

admin.domains_msg_platform_primary: A subdomain given by the platform, and the main domain now — the admin is always reachable here; it cannot be removed.

admin.domains_msg_wait_remove_on: Removed automatically on :date if still not pointed.
admin.domains_msg_claim: This domain is attached to another website. Add the verification record below to prove you own the domain, then press Check.
admin.domains_msg_verified: The domain is pointed correctly. Turn on the secure connection: the address will start with https:// and show a padlock.
admin.domains_msg_issuing: Usually under 2 minutes. You may leave the page — the bell tells you when it is done.
admin.domains_https_err_notpointed: The domain does not point to the system yet, so it could not be turned on. Check the pointing table, then press Try again.
admin.domains_https_err_notpointed_adv: The certificate authority found no DNS record pointing to the target address.
admin.domains_https_err_elsewhere: The domain points somewhere else. Delete the old record at your registrar, then press Try again.
admin.domains_https_err_elsewhere_adv: An old A or AAAA record still points to another server — delete those records.
admin.domains_https_err_proxy: The domain goes through an intermediary layer, so it could not be turned on.
admin.domains_https_err_proxy_adv: If you use Cloudflare: switch this record to “DNS only” (grey cloud) while turning it on; you can switch it back afterwards.
admin.domains_https_err_caa: The domain's settings block the issuer of the secure connection.
admin.domains_https_err_caa_adv: The CAA record does not allow Let’s Encrypt — add letsencrypt.org to CAA or delete the CAA record.
admin.domains_https_err_ratelimit: Tried many times just now — try again in 5 minutes.
admin.domains_https_err_ratelimit_adv: The certificate authority limits the number of tries per domain.

admin.domains_msg_failing_primary: Meanwhile the website runs on the remaining domains.
admin.domains_msg_expiring: :n days left: the domain still does not point to the website and stops working here on :date.

admin.domains_msg_lost: Stopped on the website — point it again and press Check to run it again.
admin.domains_msg_active_primary: Visitors open the website at https://:host. The other domains redirect here.
admin.domains_msg_active_other: Visitors who open this domain are sent to :host.

admin.domains_point_moved_toast: After moving the records, add the 2 records again at the new place, then press Check.

admin.wf.toggle_on_title: Turn the workflow back on for :name

admin.wf.error_body: The connection to the server is unsteady. Your content and settings are untouched — please try again.
admin.wf.empty_title: No content type on this website needs approval yet

admin.wf.pick_hint: Choose a workflow and preview its steps below. This content type changes how it publishes only when you press apply.
admin.wf.none_desc: No waiting step. Anyone allowed to publish has the post go live as soon as it is saved.
admin.wf.none_info: This content type will have no waiting step: anyone allowed to publish has the post go live as soon as it is saved. Posts awaiting approval are not deleted — they just go back to normal publishing.

admin.wf.moves_title: Step buttons and the permission each needs
admin.wf.apply_why_same: This content type already uses that choice
admin.wf.apply_go_title: Apply and turn it on now
admin.wf.cf_none_text: :count posts awaiting approval go back to normal publishing; nothing is lost. The past approval history is kept.
admin.wf.turn_off_confirm: :count posts awaiting approval go back to normal publishing; nothing is lost. Anyone allowed to publish can publish right after saving.

admin.wf.up_intro: This workflow adds a review step, suited to two or more people reading a post before it goes live.
admin.wf.up_current: The website is on the :plan plan, so it cannot be turned on yet.
admin.wf.up_current_none: The website has no plan yet, so it cannot be turned on yet.

admin.wf.up_need_none: No plan offers this workflow yet. Content types already running are not affected.

admin.wf.no_sections: This site has no content types an approval flow could govern yet.

admin.wf.locked_error: The multi-stage editorial flow belongs to a higher plan this site doesn't have yet. Contact your provider to upgrade.
admin.wf.return_group: Send back or take down — a reason is always required
admin.wf.empty_cta: Turn on for the first type

admin.wfb.missing_line: This post is still missing :fields. You can move it on, but filling these in first saves the reviewer sending it back.
admin.wfb.actions_title: What you can do at this step

admin.wfb.actions_hint_next: The next step in this workflow is “:label”.

admin.wfb.trail_empty: No moves yet. When you or someone else moves the post, who did what and why shows up here.

admin.wfb.modal_return: The post goes back to the writer at “:label”. Nothing written is lost.

admin.wfb.note_missing: Please give a reason so the writer knows what to fix.
admin.wfb.assign_hint: Only people who can handle the next step are listed. Leave it empty and the whole team sees the post in the review inbox.
admin.wfb.assignee_invalid: This person cannot handle the next step — pick someone from the list.
admin.wfb.err_not_governed: This content type no longer runs an approval workflow. Reload the page to publish the usual way.
admin.wfb.err_stale: The post was just moved elsewhere, or the workflow changed. Reload the page to see its current status — nothing is lost.
admin.wfb.err_forbidden: Your role is not allowed to perform this action.

entries.bulk_failed: :count could not be done — open each to see why.

entries.bulk_skipped_trash: :count skipped — not in the Trash, or not yours to change.

entries.trash_kids_too_many: Not moved: this page has too many sub-pages below it (more than :max pages, or deeper than :depth levels). Move some of its sub-pages to the Trash first, then try again.
entries.home_trash_why: To remove this page, first choose another page as the Home page.
entries.grip_title: Drag to change its place — or use Move up, Move down, Move to… in the ⋯ menu
entries.move_off_why: The list is searched, filtered or sorted another way — clear the filters and choose “Website order” to change the order
entries.move_at_top: The page is already first in its group.
entries.move_at_bottom: The page is already last in its group.
entries.move_suffix_live: · the old address :old now leads to :new
entries.move_refused_home_locked: The Home page keeps its place in the page tree.
entries.move_refused_parent_home: The Home page has no sub-pages.
entries.move_refused_cycle: A page cannot be moved into itself or one of its sub-pages.
entries.move_refused_change_held: This page is live and has edits waiting in its pending change, so its parent page cannot change yet. Once the change is on the website, the page can be moved.
entries.move_refused_subpage_held: A live page under this one takes your edits into a pending change, so this page cannot get a new parent yet: the move would change that page's address at once, without approval.
entries.move_refused_branch_too_big: This page has too many sub-pages to move at once.
entries.move_depth_page: Pages go at most three levels deep. This page can only go under a level 1 or level 2 page.
entries.move_depth_branch_l1: Pages go at most three levels deep. This branch has :n levels, so it can only go under a level 1 page.
entries.move_depth_branch_top: Pages go at most three levels deep. This branch has :n levels, so it can only go at the top level.
entries.move_path_taken: The path :path is used by another page — change the path of one of the two pages first.
entries.move_path_taken_label: A page already uses the path :path
entries.mv_search: Find a page to put it under
entries.mv_hint: Choose the new parent page. The page's path (and its sub-pages') changes with it; the old address leads to the new one by itself.
entries.mv_hint_flat: Choose the new parent page. The page's path stays the same.
entries.mv_pick_first: Choose a place in the list first.
entries.flat_note_filter: Because of the search or filter, pages show as a flat list with their parent pages in front. Drag-and-drop reordering is off for now — clear the filters to reorder.
entries.flat_note_sort: Because the list is sorted by another column, pages show as a flat list and drag-and-drop is off for now.
entries.mv_more: The website has many pages, so only the first :n places in website order are shown.
entries.move_refused_siblings_too_many: This group has too many pages to reorder at once.
entries.home_sched_why: The Home page is live: scheduling it would hide it until that time. To schedule this page, first choose another page as the Home page.
entries.home_offline_why: The Home page is live: changing its status would take it off the website, and visitors to the website's main address would find no page. To change this page's status, first choose another page as the Home page.
entries.home_expiry_why: The Home page cannot have a time to leave the website: from then on, visitors to the website's main address would find no page. To set one, first choose another page as the Home page.
entries.expiry_past: That take-off time has passed. Pick a time after now, or press «Clear the take-off time» so it does not come off by itself.
entries.expiry_before_publish: The time to leave the website must be after the scheduled publish time (:time). Pick a later time.
entries.expiry_invalid: This time cannot be read. Pick the day and time again on the calendar.
entries.expired_publish_why: This content is past its time to leave the website, so it cannot be published. Move that time to after the publish time, or clear it, then publish again.
entries.title_empty_kept: The title cannot be empty — the old title is kept.
entries.sched_for: “:title” will go live on the website at the time you choose.
entries.sched_hint: Website time, 24-hour — for example 05/08/2026 08:00. At that time the :noun appears on the website.
entries.sched_err_empty: Choose a publishing date and time.
entries.sched_err_past: That time has passed. Choose a time after now.
entries.err_approved_later: Approved and scheduled — locked for editing until it goes live. To change it, press «Cancel schedule» first.
entries.unsched_text: The :noun will no longer go live at :time on :date and goes back to the «:step» step to be edited.
entries.unsched_done: Schedule cancelled — the :noun is back at «:step»
entries.trash_ask_kids_title: Move this page and its :count sub-pages to the Trash?
entries.trash_ask_kids_text: Sub-pages go with their parent so their addresses do not break. You can restore them for :days days.
entries.skip_home_note: The Home page was left out — to remove it, make another page the Home page first.
entries.skip_has_kids: with sub-pages — move these one at a time
entries.skip_kids_note: Pages with sub-pages were left out — move each one from its own row, and its sub-pages go with it.
entries.destroy_ask_text_one: Every language version of this :noun is deleted and cannot be restored.
entries.destroy_ask_text: Every language version of :count :noun is deleted and cannot be restored.

entries.err_blocks_invalid: The block list is not valid.
entries.err_blocks_too_many: The page has too many blocks (:max max).

entries.err_block_list_min: Block :type needs at least :min items. Add more or remove the block.

entries.err_block_number_range: Block :type has a number out of range: it must be from :min to :max.
entries.err_block_lines_max: Block :type has too many lines. Keep at most :max lines, one per line.
entries.err_block_html_invalid: The formatted text could not be read. Type it again in the text editor.
entries.err_block_html_too_long: The formatted text is too long: keep it to at most :max characters, or split it into two blocks.
entries.product_pick_gone: This product no longer exists or is not published. Remove it from the list or pick another.
entries.err_status_needs_publish_flow: The “:status” status goes through publishing; it cannot be set directly.
entries.err_status_forbidden: You don't have permission to change the status of this content.
entries.err_schedule_in_past: A schedule needs a time in the future.
entries.err_create_forbidden: You don't have permission to create content.
entries.err_publish_forbidden: You don't have permission to publish this content or submit it for review.
entries.err_update_forbidden: You don't have permission to edit this content.
entries.revision_err_slug_taken: This version's address is now used by other content. Change the address of one of them, then restore again.
entries.revision_err_subpage_path_taken: The version could not be restored: a sub-page of this page would move to :path, and that path is already used by other content. Change the path of that sub-page (or of the other content), then restore again.
entries.revision_err_locale_disabled: This version is in a language that is turned off on the website. Turn the language back on to restore it.
entries.revision_err_snapshot_incompatib: This version can no longer be restored: its layout uses parts the editor no longer offers.
entries.revision_err_entry_trashed: This content is in the Trash. Restore it from the Trash first, then restore the version.
entries.revision_err_approved_later: Approved and scheduled — locked for editing until it goes live. To change it, press «Cancel schedule» first.

entries.rev.empty_title: History starts with the first publish
entries.rev.empty_hint: Each time the :unit goes on the website or is saved while public, a version is kept for you to view or restore. A draft never published has no history.
entries.rev.load_err: The version history could not be loaded — check the connection and try again.
entries.rev.load_err_all: The version history could not be loaded — check the connection and try again. What you are editing is not affected.
entries.rev.all_sub_multi: Each language has its own history. Website time (:zone).
entries.rev.legend: Reasons: Original — there before history was turned on · Publish — when it went on the website · Edited while public · Restore. The newest :keep versions of each language are always kept; older ones go after :days days.
entries.rev.tip_baseline: Content that was there before the website turned on version history
entries.rev.tip_publish: When it went on the website — Publish pressed, the scheduled time reached, or approval done
entries.rev.tip_restore: The content of an earlier version written back
entries.rev.sum_latest: This is the newest version in the history.
entries.rev.sum_latest_diff: This is the newest version in the history. You have :count unsaved changes since — each place that differs has a yellow background and the label “Differs from now”.
entries.rev.sum_diff: Differs from the current content in :count places — each has a yellow background and the label “Differs from now”.
entries.rev.sum_same: Exactly the same as the current content.
entries.rev.gone_h: In the current content, not in this version
entries.rev.ask_pub: The :unit is public — visitors see this content as soon as you press Restore, as when you press Save.
entries.rev.ask_status: The status stays as it is: :status. This only replaces the content; nothing is published or taken down.
entries.rev.ask_copy: A new version is added to the history and none is deleted — to go back, restore that one.
entries.rev.ask_one_loc: Only the :lang version changes — other languages stay as they are.
entries.rev.ask_shared: The featured image and layout are shared — every language changes with them.
entries.rev.ask_dirty: You have unsaved changes in this version — restoring replaces them with the earlier content.
entries.rev.ask_missing: :count images in this version are no longer in the library — they will be left empty; the text around them stays.
entries.rev.done_live: The version of :at is restored — visitors see this content now.
entries.rev.done_kept: The version of :at is restored — the status stays as it is.
entries.rev.done_dropped: :count images no longer in the library were left empty.
entries.rev.note_shared: The featured image and layout changed for every language.
entries.rev.gone: That version is no longer in the history. The list was loaded again.
entries.change_err_change_locked: This change was sent for review. Ask the reviewer to return it to keep editing.
entries.change_err_change_pending: This change is waiting for review, so it cannot be discarded now. Ask the reviewer to return it first.
entries.change_err_change_stale: The change was just edited or handled elsewhere. Reload the page to see the latest version — nothing is lost.
entries.change_err_not_live: This post is not on the website, so edits go straight onto it — no pending change is needed.
entries.change_err_content_invalid: The change is not valid yet: check the title, address, layout and category, then save again.
entries.change_err_category_governed: This category would take the post out of its approval workflow. Pick a category in the same section.
entries.change_err_locale_disabled: This language is switched off on the website. Switch it back on to save the change.
entries.change_err_slug_taken: The change's address is now used by other content. Change the address and try again.
entries.change_err_subpage_path_taken: The change could not go live: a sub-page of this page would move to :path, and that path is already used by other content. Change the path of that sub-page (or of the other content), then try again.
entries.change_err_workflow_governed: This post follows an approval workflow — the change must be approved rather than put on the website directly.
entries.change_err_change_open: Cannot schedule yet: this content has a pending change. Put that change on the website or discard it first.
entries.revision_err_change_pending: This content's pending change is waiting for review, so a version cannot be restored into it. Ask the reviewer to return it first.
entries.err_edit_in_change: Open the editor to edit this :noun: the edit is kept in a pending change while visitors see the current version.
entries.ed.change_parent: A live page's parent cannot be changed in a pending change. Put the change on the website first, then change the parent.
entries.ed.change_cats: A pending change keeps the main category only. Change the other categories once the change is on the website.
entries.rev.done_change: The version of :at is restored into the pending change — visitors still see the current version.
entries.chg.head_wait: Your change is waiting for someone who may publish to put it on the website
entries.chg.head_open: A change is waiting to go live (:by, :at)
entries.chg.head_sent: This :noun has a change waiting for review (:by, :at)
entries.chg.head_draft: This :noun has a change not sent for review yet (:by, :at)
entries.chg.head_editing: You are editing a live :noun — visitors still see the current version
entries.chg.sub_old: Visitors still see the current version.
entries.chg.sub_merge: Further edits are merged into this change.
entries.chg.sub_locked: The change is locked until the reviewer returns it with a note.
entries.chg.sub_returned: Note: “:note” — keep editing, then press Send change for review. Visitors still see the current version.
entries.chg.sub_draft: Visitors still see the current version — press Send change for review when done.
entries.chg.sub_editing_wf: Press Send change for review when done; the :noun goes live once approved.
entries.chg.sub_editing: Press Save change — someone who may publish will put it on the website.
entries.chg.ask_now: Visitors see it as soon as you press. The version on the website now is kept in Version history to restore.
entries.chg.ask_draft: The :langs version is a draft — it goes on the website this time too.
entries.chg.ask_unsaved: What you typed on this page is not in the change and will be dropped when you approve.
entries.chg.discard_live: The :noun on the website stays as it is.
entries.chg.discard_gone: Once discarded, it cannot be brought back.
entries.chg.diff_title: Compare with the version on the website
entries.chg.diff_sub: :n differences · :langs. The top line is the new version, the line below is what visitors see.
entries.chg.diff_none: Nothing differs from the version on the website yet.
entries.chg.return_hint: The writer reads this note and keeps editing. Visitors still see the current version.
entries.chg.return_err: A note is needed so the writer knows what to fix, for example “Fix the 2026 price paragraph”.
entries.chg.t_same: Nothing differs from the version on the website yet.
entries.chg.t_sent: Change sent for review — visitors see the current version until it is approved.
entries.chg.t_saved_wf: Change saved (not sent for review) — visitors still see the current version.
entries.chg.t_saved: Change saved — visitors see the current version until someone who may publish puts it live.
entries.chg.t_approved: Approved — visitors see it now: :langs. The previous version is in Version history.
entries.chg.t_applied: Website updated — visitors see it now: :langs. The previous version is in Version history.
entries.chg.t_discarded: Change discarded — the :noun on the website stays as it is.
entries.chg.t_returned: Change returned with a note — :by can keep editing.
entries.chg.t_folded: The pending change was merged into the :noun — no word lost.

admin.plans_price_hint: The platform does not take payments through this page yet. Prices and invoices come in a later phase.
admin.plans_leave_body: You have :n unsaved changes in :name. Leaving now loses them.
admin.plans_f_workflow_ben: Posts go through a reviewer before they appear on the website.
admin.plans_f_sites_ben: How many websites a customer may create, counted across the customer.
admin.plans_f_media_ben: Room for each website's images and files.
admin.plans_f_media_see: :n MB for images & files per website
admin.plans_f_locales_ben: How many languages a website is written in and shown in.
admin.plans_f_domains_ben: The customer's own domain, for example cokhianvinh.vn. With and without www count as 1.
admin.plans_f_domains_see_none: Only the platform's address, no custom domain
admin.plans_f_users_ben: How many people a website may have: its members plus the invitations still waiting. A website that already has more keeps everyone, but cannot invite more.
admin.plans_f_roles_ben: Create roles beyond the built-in ones.
admin.plans_f_scopes_ben: Let each member work only in some categories.
admin.plans_f_scopes_on: Can set a work scope for each member
admin.account.title: My account
admin.account.desc: Your own profile, password, two-step verification, signed-in devices and display options.
admin.account.ro_body: This can't be done while support staff are signed in on a member's behalf.
admin.account.ses_intro: See a device you do not know? Sign it out, then change your password under Security. A signed-out device has to sign in again.
admin.account.ses_intro_none: There are no other devices to sign out.
admin.account.ses_only_me: Only this device is signed in.
admin.account.ses_out_support: The support staff session has ended.
admin.account.ses_gone: That device is already signed out.
admin.account.ses_failed: Could not sign out. Try again in a few minutes.
admin.account.avatar_hint: Your initials are used for now. Uploading a picture comes in a later version.
admin.account.name: Full name
admin.account.name_hint: Shown in the top corner and in the activity log.
admin.account.name_required: Enter your full name so colleagues recognise you, for example Jane Smith.
admin.account.name_too_long: A name can be at most 120 characters — remove :count.
admin.account.job_title_hint: Colleagues see it in the member list.
admin.account.title_too_long: A job title can be at most 80 characters — remove :count.
admin.account.title_markup: A job title cannot use < or > — remove them.
admin.account.phone_hint: So colleagues can call you when needed. Optional. This number shows on every website you belong to, to whoever manages that website's members.
admin.account.phone_bad: This phone number is not valid. Enter a Vietnamese number of 10–11 digits starting with 0, for example 0901 234 567, or a foreign number starting with + and the country code, for example +65 6123 4567.
admin.account.email_hint: This email signs you in to every website you belong to and receives invitations.
admin.account.em_new_bad: This email is not in the right form, for example name@company.com.
admin.account.em_new_same: This is the email you use now. Enter a new address.
admin.account.em_no_password: This account has no password yet, so its email cannot be changed. Sign out, press "Forgot password" on the sign-in page to set one, then change the email.
admin.account.em_code_wrong: The code is not right. Open the newest email sent to :email and type the 6 digits in it.
admin.account.em_code_expired: This code has expired. Press "Send the code again" for a new one.
admin.account.em_locked: Too many wrong tries. Press "Send the code again" for a new code.
admin.account.em_recovery_wrong: This recovery code is not right or was already used. Each code works once.
admin.account.em_gone: This email change has expired. Start again.
admin.account.em_taken: The email cannot be changed to this address. If it belongs to another account of yours, ask support for help.
admin.account.em_resent: The code was sent again to :email.
admin.account.em_wait: A code was just sent. Wait a moment, then press "Send the code again".
admin.account.em_done: Your sign-in email was changed. A notice went to the old address.
admin.account.em_done_others: Your sign-in email was changed. A notice went to the old address. :count other devices were signed out.
admin.account.em_done_others_kept: Your sign-in email was changed and a notice went to the old address, but the other devices could not be signed out. Open "Signed-in devices" and press "Sign out all other devices".
admin.account.pw_new_hint: At least 10 characters. Easy to remember, hard to guess: join 3–4 words, for example "coffee-at-seven-sharp".
admin.account.pw_others: Every other device will be signed out. The device you are using stays signed in.
admin.account.pw_done_others: Password changed. :count other devices were signed out.
admin.account.pw_current_required: Enter the password you use now.
admin.account.pw_current_wrong: The current password is not right. Type it again, or sign out and press "Forgot password" on the sign-in page.
admin.account.pw_new_required: Enter a new password of at least 10 characters.
admin.account.pw_new_short: The new password needs at least 10 characters — :count more to go.
admin.account.pw_breached: This password has leaked online, so it is easy to guess. Choose another, for example a few words you remember easily.
admin.account.pw_new_same: The new password must differ from the current one.
admin.account.pw_confirm_required: Repeat the new password to be sure you typed it right.
admin.account.pw_confirm_mismatch: The two passwords don't match. Type it again exactly as in New password.
admin.account.st_2_tip: add numbers or characters like - _ ! to make it stronger.
admin.account.throttled: Too many wrong tries. Try again in :seconds seconds.
admin.account.tfa_intro: Add a second lock with your phone: each time you sign in, after the password you also type the 6-digit code shown in your phone's authenticator app. Someone who knows your password still can't get in.
admin.account.tfa_need_body: A phone with a free authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
admin.account.tfa_qr_label: QR code to scan with the authenticator app
admin.account.tfa_scan_1: Open the authenticator app on your phone.
admin.account.tfa_scan_2: Choose "Add account", then "Scan a QR code".
admin.account.tfa_scan_3: Point the camera at the code next to this.
admin.account.tfa_key_label: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
admin.account.tfa_code_hint: The code changes every 30 seconds — enter the one showing now.
admin.account.tfa_code_format: The code is exactly 6 digits, for example 123 456.
admin.account.tfa_code_wrong: That code is not valid. Open the app and enter the 6 digits showing now — the code changes every 30 seconds.
admin.account.tfa_codes_warn: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe — each one works once if you lose your device. They are shown only this once.
admin.account.codes_kept: I have kept these 8 codes somewhere safe
admin.account.codes_done_hint: Tick "I have kept" above to finish.
admin.account.tfa_codes_left: Recovery codes: :count/8 unused. Make a new set when they run out or leak.
admin.account.tfa_disable_body: Only your password will protect the account. You need to enter your password; an alert goes to your bell and email.
admin.account.dlg_disable_body: Only your password will protect the account. This is recorded and an alert goes to your bell and email. Turning it on again means scanning a new QR code.
admin.account.dlg_enable_body: Type your password again to start. Once it is on, this is recorded and a notice goes to your bell and email.
admin.account.dlg_regen_body: The 8 old codes stop working at once, including any you printed or copied. This can't be undone.
admin.account.dlg_codes_body: The 8 old codes no longer work.
admin.account.dlg_codes_warn: The old set no longer works. Keep the 8 new codes somewhere safe — they are shown only this once.
admin.account.dlg_pw: Enter your password to confirm it's you
admin.account.dlg_pw_required: Enter the password you use now to confirm it's you.
admin.account.dlg_pw_wrong: The password is not right. Type it again — mind capital letters and your keyboard input method.
admin.account.linked_intro: Sign in quickly with Google or Facebook instead of typing a password. You can unlink at any time; your password keeps working.
admin.account.linked_done: Linked. Next time you can sign in with this account.
admin.account.linked_none: This website has no quick sign-in turned on yet.
admin.account.linked_meta_no: Link it and next time :provider signs you straight into this account.
admin.account.linked_last_way: Set a password under Change password before unlinking, so you don't lose your way in.
admin.account.linked_auto: Next time you sign in with a Google or Facebook account that has this same email, it joins your account by itself — no duplicate account, nothing more to do.
admin.account.dlg_unlink_body: Next time you can't sign in with :provider; you'll use your email and password.
admin.account.dlg_unlink_note: Link it again any time with one tap.
admin.account.ui_intro: Changes only the admin you see; visitors to the website are not affected. Changes apply at once, the same as account menu › Display.
admin.account.lang_hint: The same choice as the language button in the top bar. Website content languages are changed in Settings › Website languages.
admin.account.fs_hint: Applies to every admin screen, for you only, and is remembered. Until you choose, the website's default size is used.
admin.account.motion_hint: Like my device: follows the "Reduce motion" setting of your phone or computer.
admin.account.contrast_hint: Darker text and borders, easier to read on a bright screen.
admin.account.ntf_intro: Choose what reaches your bell and what also comes by email. Changes apply at once. Security alerts are always on, so someone tampering with the account can't silence them first.
admin.account.ntf_ro: Signed in for support — the member's notification choices can't be changed.
admin.account.ntf_locked: Always on in both channels — can't be turned off.
admin.account.ntf_k_workflow_pending_rev: A post waits for your review
admin.account.ntf_d_workflow_pending_rev: When a writer sends a post, or a change to a published post.
admin.account.ntf_k_workflow_assigned: A post is assigned to you
admin.account.ntf_d_workflow_assigned: When a reviewer moves a post to the step you look after.
admin.account.ntf_d_workflow_returned: With the reason the reviewer wrote.
admin.account.ntf_d_workflow_published: When your post or change goes live on the website.
admin.account.ntf_d_workflow_scheduled: When a post is approved with a time to go live, when it goes live on its own, when the schedule is cancelled, or when the time comes and it could not go live.
admin.account.ntf_d_lead_new: Sent to everyone who can see contact requests.
admin.account.ntf_d_security_two_factor_: As soon as two-step verification on the account is turned on or off.
admin.account.ntf_k_security_support_sig: Support staff signed in as a member
admin.account.ntf_d_security_support_sig: With the reason; sent to every website owner.
admin.account.ntf_k_security_domain_take: Domain taken back by another website
admin.account.ntf_d_security_domain_take: When another website proves it owns your domain.
admin.account.ntf_d_system_domain_proble: The domain no longer points to the website, is about to stop, has stopped or works again.
admin.account.ntf_d_member_access_reques: When a member below you presses “Ask for access”.
admin.account.ntf_d_member_role_changed: When a manager adds or removes one of your roles.
media.lib.title: Media library
media.lib.desc_long: Every image and file you uploaded — reuse them in posts and products without uploading again.
media.lib.desc_short: Reuse them in posts and products.
media.lib.read_only: You are in view-only mode — the ":role" group cannot upload or delete files. Click an image to see its details and copy its address.
media.lib.error_title: The library could not be loaded
media.lib.error_body: The connection may have dropped. Your images and files are safe — click Try again.
media.lib.first_title: The library has no images yet
media.lib.first_body: Upload product photos, workshop photos or a PDF price list once, then pick them again in any post or product.
media.lib.first_hint: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, PDF · up to 10 MB per file
media.lib.no_folders: No folders yet. A website administrator can create folders to sort images.
media.lib.folder_name_required: Enter a folder name, for example "Project photos".
media.lib.folder_name_long: The folder name is too long — at most :max characters.
media.lib.folder_name_taken: There is already a folder with this name — choose another name.
media.lib.rename_note: Moving images to another folder does not change the image links already used on the website.
media.lib.folder_top_why: Already at the top of the list.
media.lib.folder_bottom_why: Already at the bottom of the list.
media.lib.folder_delete_l1: The folder has :n files. The files are not deleted — they go back to All images, under Unsorted.
media.lib.folder_delete_l2: Places that use the images keep them.
media.lib.folder_delete_l3: The folder has too many files to bring back after it is deleted.
media.lib.folder_delete_l4: The files move back to All images over a few minutes; the folder disappears once they are moved.
media.lib.folder_delete_ok: Delete the folder and move :n files to All images
media.lib.folder_deleted_n: Folder ":name" deleted, :n files back in All images (Unsorted).
media.lib.folder_deleted_no_undo: Folder ":name" deleted, :n files back in All images (Unsorted). The folder had too many files for Undo.
media.lib.folder_parent_gone: The folder it goes in was just deleted or moved — choose Inside again.
media.lib.reparent_why_kids: This folder holds subfolders — it cannot go inside another folder.
media.lib.reparent_why_none: There is no other top-level folder yet.
media.lib.reparent_top: None — make it a top-level folder
media.lib.reparent_name_taken: A folder with this name is already there — rename the folder, then move it again.
media.lib.reparent_gone: Could not move: the folder or the place just changed. Open it again and choose where.
media.lib.reparent_undo_gone: Could not put it back: the folder or its old place just changed.
media.lib.folder_delete_l1_kids: The folder and its subfolders hold :n files. Files are not deleted — they go back to All images, under Unsorted.
media.lib.folder_delete_empty_kids: These folders are all empty; no file is affected.
media.lib.folder_delete_ok_kids_n: Delete :k folders and move :n files back to All images
media.lib.folder_deleting: Moving the files of folder ":name" back to All images (Unsorted)… The folder disappears once they are moved; there is no Undo. If the folder is still there after a few minutes, delete it again.
media.lib.folder_undo_gone: It is too late to undo this. Create the folder again and move the files into it if you need to.
media.lib.search_label: Search by file name or image description
media.lib.sel_all_aria: Select every file on this page
media.lib.trash_note: Items in the Trash are deleted for good after :days days. Files in the Trash no longer show on the website.
media.lib.nomatch_body: There are :n files here, but none match the chosen filters.
media.lib.trash_empty_body: Items in the Trash are deleted for good after :days days. They can be restored before then.
media.lib.nosearch_body: Try a shorter word, for example "may-phay".
media.lib.unfiled_empty_title: Every file is in a folder
media.lib.unfiled_empty_body: Files that are in no folder show here.
media.lib.folder_empty_body: Select files in All images, then click Move to put them in this folder.
media.lib.ask_trash_l1: Some files are in use — moving them to the Trash removes the image from those places on the website.
media.lib.ask_trash_l2: They can be restored within :days days.
media.lib.trash_mine_n: Move your :n files to the Trash
media.lib.trash_skip_rest: The other :n files belong to someone else or are used elsewhere — you can only delete files you uploaded that are not used anywhere.
media.lib.trash_skip_all: The chosen files belong to someone else or are used elsewhere — you can only delete files you uploaded that are not used anywhere.
media.lib.restore_skip: :n files were put in the Trash by someone else — ask an administrator to restore them.
media.lib.trash_none_mine: The chosen files belong to someone else or are used elsewhere — you can only delete files you uploaded that are not used anywhere.
media.lib.ask_trash_mine_title: Move your :n files to the Trash?
media.lib.ask_trash_kept: The other :n files belong to someone else or are used elsewhere — they stay as they are.
media.lib.ask_purge_l1: Deletes :n files (:size) for good — this cannot be undone.
media.lib.ask_purge_l2: Images in a product gallery are removed from that product too.
media.drw.trash_note: This file is in the Trash and does not show on the website. It is deleted forever in :n days.
media.drw.langs_icon: The version being edited — switch it here
media.drw.line_source: This is the source version — write the description here; the other versions are typed in on their own.
media.drw.line_empty: The :name version has no description yet — type one in :name.
media.drw.alt_ph: A vertical CNC milling machine in the workshop, seen from the front
media.drw.alt_hint: The description helps Google and blind visitors understand the picture — a change here applies everywhere the picture is used.
media.drw.alt_long: The description is too long — at most :max characters.
media.drw.alt_near: The description is longer than the recommended :n characters — at most :max.
media.drw.title: Picture title
media.drw.title_hint: Shows when a visitor points at the picture on the website. It may stay empty.
media.drw.title_long: The title is too long — at most :max characters.
media.drw.save_failed: The description was not saved. Your text is still there — fix it and press Save again.
media.drw.url_hint: Paste it into an email or a social network to share this file.
media.drw.copy_failed: It could not be copied — the address is selected, press Ctrl+C to copy it.
media.drw.unused: No product or post uses this file yet.
media.drw.inline_note: Pictures placed straight into a post's text are not counted yet.
media.drw.why_restore: :name put this file in the Trash — ask an administrator to restore it.
media.drw.why_theirs: This is :name's file — you can only delete files you uploaded.
media.drw.why_used: The picture is used in :n places — ask an administrator or an editor to remove it.
media.drw.saved: Saved — changed everywhere the picture is used
media.drw.ud_body: The description you just changed is not saved. Closing now loses it.

guide.inbox.purpose: The posts waiting for you to read and decide on are here: approve, send back to the writer or move to the next step.
guide.inbox.tabs: :mine holds the posts someone handed to you. :queue holds every post at a step you can handle, shared with the team.
guide.inbox.search: Type part of a title or a sender's name and the list narrows at once.
guide.inbox.type: Pick a type to see only its posts; :all shows everything.
guide.inbox.rows: A row shows the step the post is at, who sent it and how long it has waited; a post waiting more than 3 days is bold with the words “:late”. Press a row to read the post; the square on the left picks several posts at once.
guide.inbox.reader: The post opens here: the sender, the current step along the workflow, the cover image, the content and what visitors will see on Google. Each block folds away.
guide.inbox.bar: The bar at the foot of the panel holds the buttons you may use at this step, such as approving or asking for changes. Sending back always carries a reason so the writer knows what to fix.
guide.inbox.nav: The two arrows go to the previous or next post in the list; beside them is where you are in the list.
guide.inbox.reload: Press :reload to read the list again when you expect a new post that has not appeared.
guide.roles.purpose: See what each role may do; create your own roles when the plan allows.
guide.roles.note: This screen shows only the buttons and tasks your role allows.
guide.roles.note_plan_off: Part of this screen: not turned on for this website — contact support.
guide.roles.note_plan_up: Part of this screen is not in the current plan.
guide.roles.create: Press :create, then start a blank role or duplicate an existing one.
guide.roles.chips: Press :chips to see each kind of role.
guide.roles.open: Press a role's name, for example :role, to see what it may do in each area.
guide.roles.members: Press the number of members to open Members, already filtered by that role.
guide.roles.explain: Press :explain to read a plain-words summary before saving.
guide.roles.more: The ⋮ button at the end of each row gathers that role's less used actions; delete is always last, in red. On a phone the menu opens from the bottom of the screen, its first line naming the role.
guide.ui.open_tip: Guide for this screen, matched to your permissions
guide.ui.heading: Guide · :title
guide.ui.role: You are working with the role :role: :may.
guide.ui.run: See this part on the screen (:n steps)
guide.ui.run_one: See this part on the screen (1 step)
guide.ui.offer_title_changed: How this screen works has just changed
guide.ui.offer_changed: Your role or approval workflow is not what it was before.
guide.ui.offer_text: Take the guide: about 1 minute, matched to your permissions.
guide.posts.purpose: Every item of :type on the website is here: search, filter, see each status:create and open a :unit to :goal.
guide.posts.part_main_create: Add a :unit and put it on the website
guide.posts.intro: You are working with the role :role: :may. :note
guide.posts.add_publish: Press :add to open the editor. Type the title and the content, then publish, and the :unit is on the website. Until then the :unit is kept as a draft that visitors do not see.
guide.posts.add_submit: Press :add to open the editor. When you have written it, send it for review; :who check it and publish it. Until it is published, visitors do not see the :unit.
guide.posts.add_flow: Press :add to open the editor. When you have written it, send it for review; the :unit goes through :n review steps before it reaches the website. You get a notification with the result.
guide.posts.add_flow_one: Press :add to open the editor. When you have written it, send it for review; the :unit goes through one review step before it reaches the website. You get a notification with the result.
guide.posts.add_write: Press :add to open the editor and write. Your role may not send a :unit for review yet.
guide.posts.tabs: Each tab is a status, and the number beside it is how many of each :unit it holds. A newly written :unit is under :draft; once published it moves to :published.
guide.posts.tabs_phone: To see :draft, :trash…: press :filter and choose under :status
guide.posts.review_tab: Each :unit sent by the :roles role is under the :pending tab. Press the :unit's status and choose :publish (or :schedule); if it is not ready, choose :draft and tell the writer what to change.
guide.posts.review_sheet: Each :unit sent by the :roles role is under the :filter button, :status › :pending. Press the :unit's status and choose :publish (or :schedule); if it is not ready, choose :draft and tell the writer what to change.
guide.posts.open_any: Press :edit to open the editor. You may edit every :unit.
guide.posts.open_own: For a :unit you wrote, press :edit to open the editor. You may only view other people's: press :view (published) or :preview (not yet published).
guide.posts.open_none: Press :view (a published :unit) or :preview (not yet published) to read it. Your role may view, not edit.
guide.posts.status_change: This label tells you the status of the :unit. Press :label to change it: :items. The menu holds only what you may do.
guide.posts.status_fixed: This label tells you the status of the :unit. Your role may not change it.
guide.posts.title_qe: Press the pencil beside the title to edit it right on the row. Press Enter to save, Esc to cancel. Left empty, the old title is kept.
guide.posts.title_edit: Press a title to open that :unit in the editor.
guide.posts.title_view: Press a title to see the :unit.
guide.posts.path_edit: The small line under the title is the address: the part after the domain name. Press it to edit its last part. When a published :unit changes its address, the old address forwards to the new one.
guide.posts.path_plain: The small line under the title is the address: the part after the domain name.
guide.posts.path_home: The small line under the title is the address: the part after the domain name. The home page always lives at the root address /, so its address cannot be changed.
guide.posts.langs_edit: A chip with a solid border is a version that exists, a chip with a + is one still missing, and the star marks the source. Press a chip and the editor opens that version directly, with no need to go through :edit and pick the language.
guide.posts.langs_view: A chip with a solid border is a version that exists, a dashed one is still missing, and the star marks the source. You may only view, so pressing a chip shows why.
guide.posts.langs_sum: This button sums up the language versions of the :unit: complete, or which ones are missing. Press it to choose the version to open.
guide.posts.views: The number by the title is how many times visitors have viewed the :unit since it was published. A :unit with no views yet shows no number.
guide.posts.more_items: The ⋮ button gathers the row's less used actions: :items.
guide.posts.more: The ⋮ button gathers the row's less used actions.
guide.posts.del_any: Last in the menu, in red, is moving it to the Trash: it can be restored.
guide.posts.del_own: For a :unit of yours, the menu ends with moving it to the Trash: it can be restored.
guide.posts.del_none: Your role may not delete a :unit.
guide.posts.more_tabs: This button gathers the statuses used less often: :items. Choose one and it takes its place in the row of tabs.
guide.posts.trash: A deleted :unit stays in :trash for :days days, then is deleted for good. Open it and press :restore to bring the :unit back to the list.
guide.posts.search: Type a few letters of the title or the address; with or without Vietnamese accents both work. Clear what you typed and the whole list comes back.
guide.posts.filter_one: Press :filter to narrow the list by :names. The number on the button is how many conditions are on.
guide.posts.f_trans: :name filters each :unit by whether its translations are complete, partly missing or missing
guide.posts.filter_end: . Each button lets you choose several items.
guide.posts.chips: This line says how many of each :unit were found and lists every condition in use. Press a label to remove just that condition, or :clear to remove them all.
guide.posts.chips_sort: This line shows the sort order in use. Press its label to go back to the default order.
guide.posts.sort: Press :sort to change the order of the rows: :opts.
guide.posts.cols: Press :cols to choose which columns show: :opts. The :locked columns always show. Your choice is remembered for you.
guide.posts.head: Press :cols to sort the list by that column; press again to reverse it.

admin.adv.help.q1: Does maintenance make the website lose its place on Google?
admin.adv.help.a1: Google is told this is a short break, so it does not remove the website from search results. Do not keep maintenance on for many days.
admin.adv.help.q2: Who can still see the website during maintenance?
admin.adv.help.a2: You and the members signed in to the admin. Visitors see only the maintenance page.

admin.adv.cd.warn_slow: for every visitor, especially on phones.
admin.adv.cd.warn_safe: for this code to run, the platform has to relax one of the website's protections. Unknown code can capture what visitors type into the website.
admin.adv.cd.warn_break_b: Wrong code can break the website:
admin.adv.cd.warn_break: a broken layout or pages that will not open. If that happens, turn this switch off and the website is back as it was.
admin.adv.cd.warn_trust: The platform does not read or check the code you paste. Only paste code from a source you trust.

admin.sl.google.step2_d: APIs & Services › OAuth consent screen: choose External, enter the app name + support email, paste the 2 policy addresses from section 2 below.

admin.sl.google.step4_d: Press Download JSON, then paste the file's whole content into the quick-paste box in section 3 — no need to split the Client ID and Secret yourself.
admin.sl.google.step5_d: Go back to OAuth consent screen and press Publish app; otherwise only accounts in your team can sign in.
admin.sl.google.a1: The return address pasted into Google does not match exactly. Open Setup guide › section 2, copy the Authorized redirect URI line again (full https://, no trailing /), save in Google, then wait 1–2 minutes.
admin.sl.google.a2: The Client ID or secret key is wrong, or the key was deleted in Google. Create a new key under Credentials, paste it into the Client ID / Client Secret fields again, then press Check & save.
admin.sl.google.a3: The app is still in Testing. Go to OAuth consent screen and press Publish app — asking only for name and email needs no further review by Google.
admin.sl.google.copy.redirect_where: Credentials › OAuth client › Authorized redirect URIs
admin.sl.google.copy.redirect_why: Google sends people back only to exactly this address. One wrong character gives redirect_uri_mismatch.
admin.sl.google.copy.origin_where: Credentials › OAuth client › Authorized JavaScript origins
admin.sl.google.copy.origin_why: Lets the sign-in page call Google from the platform's domain.
admin.sl.google.copy.privacy_where: OAuth consent screen › Privacy policy link
admin.sl.google.copy.privacy_why: Google requires it to publish the app.
admin.sl.google.copy.terms_where: OAuth consent screen › Terms of service link
admin.sl.google.copy.terms_why: Required as above — paste it and you are done.
admin.sl.facebook.name: Facebook
admin.sl.facebook.id_invalid: A Facebook App ID is digits only (about 15–16 of them).
admin.sl.facebook.secret_invalid: A Facebook App Secret is exactly 32 letters and digits.
admin.sl.facebook.paste_ph: Paste the App ID and App Secret here…
admin.sl.facebook.paste_help: Copy the passage with the App ID and App Secret from Settings › Basic and paste it here — the system recognises the App ID digits and the 32-character App Secret and fills in the two fields below.
admin.sl.facebook.id_help: Settings › Basic › App ID — the 15–16 digits at the top of the app's page.
admin.sl.facebook.secret_help: Settings › Basic › App secret: press Show and enter your Facebook password again to see it. If it is lost, press Reset to get a new key.
admin.sl.facebook.step1_d: developers.facebook.com › My Apps › Create app, pick the option with Facebook Login (Consumer / Authenticate users).
admin.sl.facebook.step2_d: In the app: Add product › Facebook Login › Settings, paste the Valid OAuth Redirect URI from section 2 below.
admin.sl.facebook.step3_d: Settings › Basic: paste the App domain, Site URL, the 2 policy addresses and the Data deletion callback from section 2 below — without them Facebook will not allow Live.
admin.sl.facebook.step4_d: Settings › Basic: copy the App ID, press Show on App Secret, then paste both into the quick-paste box in section 3.
admin.sl.facebook.step5_d: Turn App Mode from Development to Live at the top of the app's page; otherwise only accounts in your team can sign in.
admin.sl.facebook.q1: “URL blocked — the redirect URI is not in the list”
admin.sl.facebook.a1: Open Setup guide › section 2, copy the Valid OAuth Redirect URI again, paste it into Facebook Login › Settings and press Save changes.
admin.sl.facebook.q2: Only I can sign in, visitors cannot
admin.sl.facebook.a2: The app is still in Development. Turn App Mode to Live at the top of the app's page and you are done.
admin.sl.facebook.q3: Facebook asks for a permission review
admin.sl.facebook.a3: The email and public_profile permissions need no review. If it still asks, check whether the app requests any other permission and remove it.
admin.sl.facebook.copy.redirect_where: Facebook Login › Settings › Valid OAuth Redirect URIs
admin.sl.facebook.copy.redirect_why: Facebook sends people back only to exactly this address; without it you get “URL blocked”.
admin.sl.facebook.copy.domain_why: Declares the domain allowed to use the app.
admin.sl.facebook.copy.site_why: The website address that represents the app.
admin.sl.facebook.copy.deletion_where: Settings › Basic › Data deletion callback URL
admin.sl.facebook.copy.deletion_why: Facebook requires a place that receives data deletion requests. The platform handles them automatically at this address.
admin.sl.facebook.copy.privacy_why: Required to switch the app to Live.
admin.sl.facebook.copy.terms_where: Settings › Basic › Terms of Service URL
admin.sl.facebook.copy.terms_why: Required as above — paste it and you are done.
admin.set.desc.social: Whatever provider the platform opens, your website has it too — switch it off if you do not want visitors to use it.
admin.set.desc.system-social: Connect Google and Facebook once for every customer website.
admin.audit.act.platform.oauth_social.ke: Saved the shared quick sign-in app's keys
admin.audit.act.platform.oauth_social.sw: Turned quick sign-in on or off for the whole system
admin.audit.act.platform.oauth_social.di: Disconnected the shared quick sign-in app
